title: Nutty Smoky Chinese Cannellini Beans Grill
description: A smoky and tender lacto-vegetarian Chinese dish featuring cannellini beans, inspired by Xinjiang cuisine, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, approximately 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, and crushed red pepper.
Add the soaked and drained cannellini beans to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the smoky sauce.
Thread the coated cannellini beans onto skewers, leaving a small space between each bean.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beans are tender and slightly charred.
While the beans are grilling, prepare the topping by mixing together chopped scallions and crumbly feta cheese.
Once the beans are done, remove from heat and top with the scallion and feta cheese mixture.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional scallions and sesame oil if desired.
